summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Money Transfers pages for Khair Baghdad Exchange. All transfer flows working correctly: Transfers Hub, Local Transfer, International Selector, Western Union, MoneyGram, Country-based Wizard (5 steps), and Transfer Success page. RTL Arabic and LTR English layouts both working correctly.

Exchange rates are hardcoded in WesternUnion.js and MoneyGram.js (e.g., USD: 1500, EUR: 1600)
Service fees are hardcoded at 2% across all transfer types
Country-based wizard has hardcoded country list and transfer methods per country

success_rate.backend: N/A - Frontend only testing (all APIs MOCKED)
